title: How to reset your password
content: To reset your password: 1) Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. 2) Enter your registered email address. 3) Check your inbox for a password reset link (valid for 24 hours). 4) Click the link and enter a new password that is at least 8 characters with one number and one special character. 5) Confirm the new password and click Save. You'll be redirected to the login page to sign in with your new password. If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder or contact support for assistance.

title: Subscription plans and pricing
content: We offer three subscription plans: Basic ($9.99/month) includes 5 projects and 10GB storage; Pro ($29.99/month) includes unlimited projects, 100GB storage, and priority support; Enterprise (custom pricing) includes everything in Pro plus dedicated support, SSO, and custom integrations. All plans come with a 14-day free trial. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time. Annual billing gives you a 20% discount on all plans.

title: Troubleshooting payment failures
content: If your payment fails, first check that your card details are up to date in Billing Settings. Common causes: expired card, insufficient funds, bank declined the transaction, incorrect CVV, or the card is not enabled for international transactions. You can retry the payment or add a different payment method. After 3 failed attempts, your account will be placed on a 7-day grace period. During this time you can still access your data but cannot create new projects. Contact your bank if issues persist.

title: How to invite team members
content: To invite team members: 1) Navigate to your Project Settings. 2) Click on the 'Members' tab. 3) Click 'Invite Member'. 4) Enter the email address of the person you want to invite. 5) Select their role: Admin (full access), Editor (can edit but not delete), Viewer (read-only). 6) Click Send Invitation. The invitee will receive an email with a link to join your project. Invitations expire after 7 days. You can revoke pending invitations from the same Members tab at any time.

title: Exporting your data
content: You can export your data at any time from Settings > Data Export. Supported formats: CSV, JSON, and PDF. You can export individual projects or your entire account. Large exports are prepared as a zip file and emailed to you when ready. Export processing time depends on data volume: small projects (under 100MB) are instant; large exports can take up to 24 hours. Your data includes all projects, documents, uploaded files, and activity logs. Exports exclude deleted items older than 30 days.

title: Cancelling your subscription
content: To cancel your subscription: 1) Go to Settings > Billing. 2) Click 'Manage Subscription'. 3) Select 'Cancel Subscription'. 4) Choose a reason for cancellation (optional but helps us improve). 5) Confirm cancellation. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing period. After cancellation, your account will be downgraded to the free tier. You'll lose access to premium features but your data will be retained for 90 days in case you reactivate. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days for annual plans canceled within 30 days of renewal.

title: Supported file formats for upload
content: We support the following file formats: Documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, RTF, ODT), Images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, SVG), Spreadsheets (XLSX, CSV, ODS), Presentations (PPTX, ODP), and Archives (ZIP, RAR, 7Z). Maximum file size is 100MB per file for Pro and Enterprise plans, 25MB for Basic plans. Files larger than these limits cannot be uploaded through the web interface but can be added via our API (up to 500MB). Certain file types like executables (.exe, .sh, .bat) and scripts (.js, .py, .php) are blocked for security reasons.

title: Setting up two-factor authentication
content: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable: 1) Go to Settings > Security. 2) Click 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication'. 3) Install an authenticator app like Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone. 4) Scan the QR code displayed on screen. 5) Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to verify setup. 6) Save your backup codes (store them somewhere safe — they are the only way to recover access if you lose your phone). Once enabled, you'll need both your password and a 6-digit code to log in.

title: API rate limits and best practices
content: Our API has the following rate limits: 60 requests per minute for authenticated users, 10 requests per minute for unauthenticated users. Rate limits reset every minute. If you exceed the limit, you'll receive a 429 Too Many Requests response. Best practices: 1) Implement exponential backoff for retries. 2) Cache responses when possible. 3) Use bulk endpoints instead of individual requests. 4) The X-RateLimit-Remaining header tells you how many requests you have left. Contact us for higher limits on Enterprise plans.

title: Common browser compatibility issues
content: Our platform supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Common issues and fixes: 1) White screen or page not loading — clear browser cache and cookies, or try incognito mode. 2) Features not working — disable browser extensions, especially ad-blockers. 3) Slow performance — close unused tabs, check your internet connection, or try a wired connection. 4) File upload failures — ensure your browser is updated to the latest version. We do not support Internet Explorer at all.

title: Understanding the dashboard analytics
content: The dashboard analytics show key metrics for your projects: Active Users (unique users who interacted in the last 30 days), Response Time (average time for a first response to customer inquiries), Resolution Rate (percentage of tickets resolved within SLA), Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT, scale 1-5, calculated from post-resolution surveys), and Ticket Volume (total tickets by day/week/month). You can filter by date range, project, or team member. Data is updated in real-time with a maximum 5-minute delay. Export any report as CSV or PDF from the export button in the top-right corner.

title: How to merge duplicate accounts
content: If you have multiple accounts, you can merge them by contacting support. Before requesting a merge: 1) Make sure both accounts use the same email address or verify ownership of both accounts. 2) Decide which account will be the primary (retained) account — all data from the secondary account will be transferred to the primary. 3) Note that subscription plans cannot be combined; you'll need to choose one active subscription. 4) Data from the secondary account (projects, files, settings) will be transferred within 48 hours. Merged accounts cannot be un-merged.

title: Best practices for ticket prioritization
content: Effective ticket prioritization helps teams resolve issues efficiently. We recommend: 1) Urgent (respond within 1 hour) — system outages, security breaches, data loss. 2) High (respond within 4 hours) — feature broken for all users, payment issues. 3) Medium (respond within 8 hours) — feature broken for some users, incorrect behavior. 4) Low (respond within 24 hours) — feature requests, minor bugs, general questions. Use the SLAs feature to automatically escalate tickets that miss their response targets. Re-evaluate priority after initial triage if more information becomes available.

title: Creating custom email templates
content: Custom email templates let you standardize your responses. To create one: 1) Go to Settings > Email Templates. 2) Click 'New Template'. 3) Give it a name and select a category (e.g., 'Password Reset', 'Welcome', 'Invoice'). 4) Design your template using our drag-and-drop editor or write HTML directly. 5) Use merge tags like {{customer_name}}, {{ticket_id}}, {{issue_description}} to personalize emails. 6) Test your template by sending a preview to yourself. 7) Save and activate. You can set up automation rules to trigger specific templates based on ticket category or customer action.

title: Integrating with Slack
content: To integrate with Slack: 1) Go to Settings > Integrations > Slack. 2) Click 'Connect to Slack'. 3) Authorize the app by selecting your Slack workspace. 4) Choose what notifications you want to receive (new tickets, priority changes, mentions, SLA breaches). 5) Select the Slack channel where notifications will be posted. 6) Configure the notification format (compact or detailed). You can connect multiple Slack workspaces and channels for different projects. To disconnect, go back to the integration settings and click 'Disconnect'. Notifications can be paused for up to 24 hours from the Do Not Disturb settings.
